description: Worke helps authenticated users find and inspect contacts, inquiries, contracts, assets and loans, calendar events, attendance status and purchase-pairing data from their company workspace, and answers analysis questions in one call: how a contract is doing (agreed price, invoiced, costs by kind, margin), what the company has with a customer, how a salesperson performs over a period, and how the inquiry funnel converts. Every tool is read-only and results are limited by each user's existing Worke permissions.

defaultPrompt: Show today’s Worke calendar events and my current attendance status. Summarize what I need to prepare for.
Show the newest open inquiries in Worke, summarize which ones may need follow-up, and include links to their details.
List my active Worke contracts and show the available insights for the most recently updated contract.
